# Larkspur Support · integration guide

Base URL   https://interlock.example/v1
Model      larkspur-support
Auth       Authorization: Bearer $INTERLOCK_KEY

## Endpoints
POST /chat/completions   ask, with streaming
GET  /models             list published apps

## MCP
Server     https://interlock.example/mcp/larkspur-support
Tools      ask_larkspur-support, search_kb_help

## Examples
curl https://interlock.example/v1/chat/completions   -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERLOCK_KEY"   -d '{"model": "larkspur-support", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Can I get a refund?"}]}'
